snippet.title: Slice of Life - Gameplay Breakdown - Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
Join Slice of Life creator Michael LeRoy on a tour through Rosegate University! All gameplay footage was recorded on a Nintendo Switch console.

Coming to Nintendo eShop on October 8th, 2021
for $6.99!
